content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 22.14 is the sole solicitation covenant and binds Tri City National Bank as well as M&I. It is mutual (already met), but it covers *all* employees of the other party for the entire Term with no carve-outs — all-personnel scope and an over-24-month duration fall into walk-away territory and fail the fallback. I proposed a single surgical replacement narrowing scope to personnel directly involved in the Services, capping duration at twelve months after involvement ends, and adding general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, leaving the clause solicitation-only (no no-hire) and the heading and mutuality untouched.
